Arch Linux is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2019 to 2019.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [server-archlinux](@/work/server-archlinux.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Arch Linux: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic.
